visual_brief.subject: Agent Skills joins MCP under the Linux Foundation's neutral Agentic AI Foundation
verified_context: Google says Anthropic donated the Agent Skills specification to the Agentic AI Foundation, the same neutral foundation that hosts MCP.
MCP describes tool and data connectivity, while Agent Skills packages procedural instructions, scripts and supporting resources.
The governance change does not make every skill portable or secure; conformance, versioning and independent implementations remain future evidence.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Two distinct modular channels keep their roles separate while locking into one shared foundation whose joints remain visibly unfinished.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A dark connectivity channel and a layered procedural channel converge on a shared stone plinth through separate terracotta joints, with one open socket signaling unfinished conformance.

candidate_notes.A: Rejected after comparison. The two channels and open socket are clear, but generic gear symbols introduce an unnecessary product-tool shorthand.
candidate_notes.B: Selected. The connectivity module and layered procedural package remain distinct while attaching to one neutral chassis, and an empty socket preserves the unfinished conformance story.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant, but the scenic bridge-and-island treatment weakens the specification-level distinction and the shared-governance focus at thumbnail scale.

crop_review.article_desktop: The connectivity module, procedural package, shared chassis and empty conformance socket remain visible in the 1600×900 hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered cover crop retains both modules and their separate terracotta couplings; the open socket remains visible.
crop_review.thumbnail: The two distinct module silhouettes and shared base remain immediately legible at 320px.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate follows the tooling references through modular tactile objects, a restrained warm field, charcoal and paper contrast, sparse terracotta couplings and a strong center-safe still-life composition.
